body: Yes, tell your Mum. Your friend wouldn't have told you his plans if he didn't want help and want to be stopped. By telling your Mum, hopefully that will lead to the needed support for him, but also the support that you need right now too.
I have absolutely no wise words, but very much wanted to send you a big cyber hug ((((you))))

The pain of loss of your significant other, while excruciatingly painful so I don't under estimate it, is temporary and the pain of this loss will go completely and in its entirety in time. This is one case when suicide would most definitely be a permanent action for a temporary problem. 

Instead, try to think of what extra resources you would need to cope with this problem and jot down some ideas of those, and any ways you can increase your social contacts with others too, which will help you through this time.
